test.title: Straight Lines - Test 1
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

The arithmetic mean of the reciprocals of the intercepts of this line on the coordinate axes is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></math>. Then which of these stones is<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>/</mo></math>are on the path of the man?

Then, the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>β</mi></math> is equal to _____.
